          Legal

          Privacy policy

          Last updated 30 October 2026

          HigherUp.AI is a hackathon prototype. This policy explains in plain language how the prototype handles information. It will be reviewed before any public launch.

          What we collect

          • Account details: your email address, name and whether you are a candidate or a recruiter.
          • Profile details you choose to add: headline, phone, city, availability, education, links and a short bio.
          • Documents you upload: resume or CV, cover letter, certificates and other proof of your skills.
          • Job preferences: preferred roles, locations, work mode and salary expectations.
          • Recruiter activity: role criteria, scoring weights, shortlist and pass decisions, and audit events.

          How we use it

          • To build your Skill Passport, suggest suitable jobs and internships, and explain every match score.
          • To show recruiters a role-specific one-page summary containing only the fields they selected.
          • To keep an audit trail of criteria changes and hiring decisions so they can be reviewed for fairness.

          What never affects your score

          Gender, age, caste, religion, disability, college name, degree status and payment status have zero weight in matching. Missing information lowers confidence; it is never guessed. AI supports screening, but people make every hiring decision.

          Where it is stored

          Your login account is managed by Supabase. Candidate profile details, job preferences and uploaded documents are stored in SAP HANA. We do not sell your information.

          Your choices

          • You can view, correct or remove your profile details, documents and Skill Passport entries at any time.
          • Applications prepared by the Apply Agent are only submitted after you approve them.
          • To delete your account and data, contact the team through the project’s GitHub page.

          Legal

          Terms of use

          Last updated 30 October 2026

          HigherUp.AI is a hackathon prototype provided for demonstration and evaluation. Sample candidates, companies and jobs shown in the product are fictional.

          Using HigherUp.AI

          • Keep your login details private and provide information that is accurate and your own.
          • Only upload documents you have the right to share. Do not upload other people’s personal information.
          • Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other accounts, or upload harmful files.

          For employers and recruiters

          • Use job-relevant criteria only. Do not use the platform to discriminate on protected characteristics.
          • Match scores and summaries support your review. You remain responsible for every hiring decision.

          For candidates

          • Essential candidate features are free. Paying never increases a candidate’s ranking.
          • Match scores are guidance, not a guarantee of an interview or a job offer.

          The prototype

          The service is provided “as is” while it is being developed. Features may change, and data may be reset. These terms may be updated; the date above shows the latest version.
